items.text: You're listening to a sample from PlanRef. Class Q permits the change of use of an agricultural building to dwellinghouses, together with the building operations reasonably necessary to convert it. It is not a grant of planning permission in the ordinary sense. It is a permitted development right, given by the Town and Country Planning General Permitted Development Order 2015, and it comes with limits and conditions that must all be met before it applies. The right was substituted in full on the 21st of May 2024, so anything written or decided before that date should be checked against the new version before you rely on it. The old reference dates and floor-space figures are gone, and appeal decisions built on them describe a different right.
